item.title: Tom Golisano Investing $100 Million In Two More Children’s Hospitals In Little Rock And Augusta
item.description: Philanthropist and Paychex founder Tom Golisano announced a $100 million investment to support two additional children’s hospitals, allocating $50 million each to Arkansas Children’s in Little Rock, Arkansas, and Wellstar Children’s Hospital of Georgia in Augusta, Georgia. The gifts expand the Golisano Children’s Alliance to 12 member hospitals nationwide. item.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Announces First Close Of O’Connor Transaction
item.description: Cantor Fitzgerald announced it has completed the first closing of its acquisition of the UBS O’Connor alternative investment platform and has transferred two O’Connor hedge fund investment strategies to Cantor Fitzgerald Asset Management (CFAM). item.title: BigBear.ai Finalizes $250 Million Acquisition Of Ask Sage
item.description: BigBear.ai announced it has completed its acquisition of Ask Sage for $250 million in cash, adding a secure generative AI platform designed for deployment, orchestration, and agentic capabilities in defense, intelligence, and other highly regulated environments. item.title: MetLife Investment Management Closes PineBridge Acquisition, Creating A $734.7 Billion Global Asset Manager
item.description: MetLife Investment Management (MIM), MetLife, Inc.’s institutional asset management business, said it has completed its acquisition of PineBridge Investments, combining the firms into a platform overseeing $734.7 billion in assets under management on a pro forma basis as of September 30, 2025. item.title: OceanFirst To Acquire Flushing Financial In $579 Million All-Stock Merger
item.description: OceanFirst Financial and Flushing Financial Corporation have agreed to combine in an all-stock merger that would create a regional bank with approximately $23 billion in assets across New Jersey, Long Island, and the New York City metro area, while also bringing in a $225 million strategic equity investment from Warburg Pincus. item.title: Credicorp’s BCP To Acquire Helm Bank USA For $180 Million
item.description: Credicorp announced its Peruvian banking subsidiary, Banco de Crédito del Perú (BCP), has signed an agreement to acquire 100% of Helm Bank USA for $180 million, subject to customary price adjustments at closing. The transaction is intended to expand Credicorp’s cross-border banking capabilities for clients with financial needs spanning Latin America and the United States. item.description: Moto Finance, a New York-based fintech startup, has raised $1.8 million in pre-seed funding from Cyber Fund and Eterna Capital to develop a blockchain-powered platform that combines a high-interest savings account with a premium credit card offering. item.title: Hyatt Completes $2 Billion Sale Of Playa-Owned Resort Real Estate To Tortuga
item.description: Hyatt Hotels announced it has closed the sale of the owned real estate portfolio it previously acquired from Playa Hotels & Resorts N.V. to Tortuga Resorts for approximately $2.0 billion, completing what the company described as a fully asset-light transaction for the Playa portfolio.
